sentences.en: The young campers were kited out with new waterproof jackets.
sentences.zh: 那些年轻的露营者们穿上了新的防水夹克。

sentences.en: We had a lot of good times in our camper.
sentences.zh: 我们在我们的露营车里度过了许多愉快的时光。

sentences.en: Lots of campers were parked all over the hill-side.

senses.zh: 露营者，野营者,（装有露营设备的）露营车,房车
